🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(multiply(rank(divide(multiply(ts_ema(multiply(subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen), Volume), 10), add(1, divide(subtract(ts_delay(AdjClose, 1), AdjClose), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)))), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21))), 2), 1)
  2. 2. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(rank(divide(multiply(ts_ema(multiply(subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen), Volume), 10), add(1, divide(subtract(ts_delay(AdjClose, 1), AdjClose), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)))), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21))), 2)
  3. 3. rank —— 当日全市场排序分位(0~1)
    rank(divide(multiply(ts_ema(multiply(subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen), Volume), 10), add(1, divide(subtract(ts_delay(AdjClose, 1), AdjClose), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)))), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21)))
  4. 4. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(multiply(ts_ema(multiply(subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen), Volume), 10), add(1, divide(subtract(ts_delay(AdjClose, 1), AdjClose), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)))), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21))
  5. 5. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(ts_ema(multiply(subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen), Volume), 10), add(1, divide(subtract(ts_delay(AdjClose, 1), AdjClose), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1))))
  6. 6. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(multiply(subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen), Volume), 10)
  7. 7. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen), Volume)
  8. 8. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjClose, AdjOpen)
  9. 9. add —— 加法
    add(1, divide(subtract(ts_delay(AdjClose, 1), AdjClose), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)))
  10. 10. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(ts_delay(AdjClose, 1), AdjClose), ts_delay(AdjClose, 1))
  11. 11. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(ts_delay(AdjClose, 1), AdjClose)
  12. 12. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)
  13. 13. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 1)
  14. 14. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
rank截面 0-1 排名
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 1) ret = 日收益
  2. 2) abs_ret = |ret| 收益绝对值 (恐慌代理)
  3. 3) dollar_pressure = abs_ret * log(volume) 美元压力 = 恐慌 × 资金
  4. 4) smoothed = ema(span=8, dollar_pressure)
  5. 5) 取负: 压力越低反向越稳
  6. 6) factor = cs_rank(-smoothed)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_fear_adjusted_dollar_pressure_short_ema(df): df_copy = df.copy() dollar_imb = (df_copy["str">'close'] - df_copy["str">'open']) * df_copy["str">'volume'] smoothed_imb = dollar_imb.ewm(span=10, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() price_decline = (df_copy["str">'close'].shift(1) - df_copy["str">'close']) / df_copy["str">'close'].shift(1) fear_adj_imb = smoothed_imb * (1 + price_decline) high = df_copy["str">'high'].values.astype(np.float64) low = df_copy["str">'low'].values.astype(np.float64) close = df_copy["str">'close'].values.astype(np.float64) atr = talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=21) atr_series = pd.Series(atr, index=df_copy.index) raw = fear_adj_imb / atr_series.replace(0, np.nan) df_copy["str">'factor_fear_adjusted_dollar_pressure_short_ema'] = raw.rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) * 2 - 1 "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_fear_adjusted_dollar_pressure_short_ema']
